title: When the Prom Turns
author: Ansel Nystrom
blurb: Lior Almeida, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
